---
title: 1 Varieties
order: 1
---
Many newer varieties are all-male hybrids, whereas traditional varieties produce 50 percent male and 50 percent female plants. Male hybrids are higher yielding, more vigorous, and do not produce seeds. See Table 1.1 and consult with Extension specialists, seed company representatives, and buyers to determine the best varieties for your farm. Use only disease-free crowns from trusted sources.
